subject: Demo booking — choose a 30-minute engineer-friendly window
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barker <elliot@libris.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo booking — choose a 30-minute engineer-friendly window

Hi Elliot,

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood Inference — welcome! I wanted to circle back personally and make it very easy to get a short walkthrough tailored to your team.

Quick options: pick a 30-minute slot using my scheduler below and I’ll make sure one of our inference engineers joins for any architecture or cost questions. If you prefer, reply with the times that work for your team and we’ll coordinate.

Scheduling link: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/vanessa_ortiz/30min

Attached is a short one-page demo guide that outlines what we cover in a 30-min call so you can prep if helpful.

If you have any hard constraints (timezone, no Fridays, need an evening slot), let me know and we’ll accommodate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise SDR (West)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-demo-guide.pdf]
From: Elliot Barker <elliot@libris.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo booking — choose a 30-minute engineer-friendly window

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the quick note.

We signed up this morning; happy to do a short demo. A couple of constraints: we’re in PST and prefer mornings (9–11am). Also, no Fridays — our engineering team has sprint planning then. Could you propose a couple of morning slots next week?

Also interested in any brief pre-read on billing/throughput assumptions for smaller GP models.

Thanks,
Elliot
CTO, Libris AI
elliot@libris.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Barker <elliot@libris.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo booking — choose a 30-minute engineer-friendly window

Thanks — morning windows are perfect. I checked our engineers’ availability and can offer these 30-minute blocks (all PT):

- Tue, May 16 — 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed, May 17 — 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu, May 18 — 9:00–9:30am PT

If one of those works you can click the link below to confirm. I’ve also attached a small .ics that includes the three proposed slots so you can drop them into a shared calendar for quick review. Karthik (cc’d) will take the meeting invite and handle the follow-up paperwork if you decide to move forward.

Confirm here: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/vanessa_ortiz/30min

Quick pre-read on unit economics and throughput: refer to section 2 of the attached guide (page 1) — I’ll bring an engineer who can walk the numbers during the demo.

[Attachment: proposed-times.ics]

If none of those are good, paste 2–3 alternatives and we’ll match.

Cheers,
Vanessa
From: Elliot Barker <elliot@libris.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo booking — choose a 30-minute engineer-friendly window

Vanessa — thanks, 9:30–10:00am PT on Tue, May 16 works for us. I’ve confirmed via the scheduler and added the invite to our shared calendar. Looking forward to the throughput/billing discussion — I’ll send a short list of our typical sequence lengths and concurrent sessions before the call.

Elliot
